use_cases: Showcase product or service features on a landing page
Display feature demos with interactive hover animations
Create engaging feature comparison sections for SaaS platforms
Build visually appealing feature grids with bouncy card interactions
ai_summary: BouncyCardsFeatures is an animated feature showcase component that displays product features in a responsive grid of bouncy cards with gradient backgrounds. Uses Framer Motion for smooth hover and tap animations, creating an engaging way to present feature demos. Ideal for SaaS landing pages and product showcases where interactive feature cards enhance user engagement.
